name: Yamaha Virago 920 / 1000
engine: 920 or 981 cc air-cooled V-twin, two carbs, shaft or chain drive
intro: The early big Viragos. Two carbs, a starter that is known to give trouble, and a monoshock frame.

F: Virago starters are a known weak point. If it grinds or slips, check the starter clutch and gear before buying a new starter.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
